name: Intercos SpA
summary: Intercos S.p.A., along with its affiliated companies, specializes in the global production and sale of cosmetic products, encompassing items for skin, hair, and body maintenance. The company offers an extensive portfolio, which includes makeup essentials like foundations, concealers, face powders, eyeshadows, innovative application systems and pencils, mascaras, lipsticks and glosses, and nail polishes. Furthermore, their product line features skincare solutions such as facial and eye treatments, primers, skin perfectors, setting sprays and mists, masks, and cleansers, alongside various body and hair grooming essentials. This enterprise was established in 1972 and operates from its headquarters in Agrate Brianza, Italy.
